note: Launch pads: stand on one and press E to fly the encounter it names. Read by src/systems/flow/game_flow.gd; the owning scene resolves 'town_box' (the pad sits on that box's footprint, at its base) and 'arrive_marker' (where the player lands back on foot, facing the pad) from its own layout data, so no coordinates live here or in code. Labels are here so code stays name-free. M14: the pit's ship is flown, not quick-launched: E boards it, and flying out of the atmosphere (the world's space_altitude) starts the pad's encounter. reentry_* place the ship back in the port's sky after space (altitude in metres, distance and bearing from the pad, nose pitch); reentry_delay is how long after a won fight before re-entry happens on its own.

labels.arrive_complete: Back in port. Sector clear, +%d credits
labels.arrive_failed: Back in port. Your fighter limped home.

labels.crashed: Crashed. Your ship is being towed back to the pad.
labels.towed: Your ship is back on its pad.
labels.dive_to_land: Dive toward the planet to go back down.
labels.sector_clear_dive: Sector clear. Dive toward the planet to land.
